config.title: Build inventory reservation API

intro.title: Build inventory reservation API
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple inventory reservation API using Node.js. You'll learn how to create endpoints that allow users to check available stock and reserve items from an inventory. The core concept is handling HTTP requests and managing state with an in-memory data structure. You'll use Express.js for routing and JavaScript objects to track inventory levels, focusing on basic CRUD operations. This will give you a practical foundation in building RESTful APIs with Node.js.
intro.usecase: Inventory reservation APIs are fundamental to e-commerce platforms like Amazon and Shopify, where they prevent overselling by temporarily holding items in a customer's cart during checkout. This pattern also appears in booking systems for hotels, airlines, and event ticketing services, ensuring that a seat or room isn't double-booked while a user completes their purchase. Developers implement these APIs to manage concurrent requests and maintain data consistency across distributed systems, which is critical for any application dealing with limited inventory or resources.

objectives: Construct an Express server with routes for inventory management
Implement a data model to track product inventory and reservations
Apply validation logic to ensure reservation requests are within available stock
Configure middleware to parse JSON request bodies
Manipulate inventory data to update quantities after successful reservations
Integrate error handling for insufficient stock scenarios
Initialize a mock database structure for storing inventory state
